name: 1.23.0-beta.32
notes: Fix the conditions, for a picture made of layers: it now lists all the parts of the picture (each layer, with its picture), and marks the part that has no picture, which is what causes the error. Parts not shown now are listed too, folded away.
“Choose a picture for this part” gives a picture to the missing part only; the other parts stay as they are. The search starts from the name the other parts' files share.
